title: Asymptotically safe quantum gravity and its phenomenology -- a review
summary: Asymptotically safe quantum gravity is an approach to quantum gravity. It is based on the premise that quantum field theory can describe the quantum nature of gravity in our universe. At its core lies quantum scale symmetry. This review provides an introduction to the key ideas of the approach and surveys the current status of the field. Over the last years, the field has taken large strides towards an increasingly realistic setting: First, compelling evidence for quantum scale symmetry exists in four-dimensional, Euclidean, pure gravity, establishing the Reuter fixed point robustly.
